images.title: Keep adding the digits
images.purpose: Shows 489710 reducing to its digital root: digit sum 29, then 11, then 2.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One chain of four boxes left to right joined by arrows.
images.exact_structure: Four rounded boxes in a row joined by 3 grey (#6B7280) arrows: 489710, 29, 11, 2. The first three boxes have dark outlines; the last box, 2, is filled reddish purple (#CC79A7) and has the label digital root under it. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Adding digits again and again ends at a single digit, the digital root.
images.description: Shows 489710 reducing to its digital root: digit sum 29, then 11, then 2.

image_decisions.why: The reduction chain is the method itself.
